scores.evidence: The text is warm です・ます throughout, with no pressure phrases. §3 spacing is now consistent: 「Claude Codeに」「autoモード」「MCPサーバー」, and `bypassPermissions` is always inline code. Every card back ends in です・ます (「攻撃です。」「開きます。」). The option forms now match within each question: q2 all end 「試す」, q3 all take the 「…を書く／書かない」 form, e1 all end 「動かす」. Most wrong-option feedback names the misconception first and then the correct idea, in 2 sentences or fewer. What keeps the score at 3 is a few spots that still read loosely: the e2 d feedback has no subject, the s2-layers caption is in plain form, and 「大きな要求」 is vague.

measure.mjs gives prose 1735 (budget 1,200–2,400), read 2356, est 17.0 min (≤ 20), and estMinutes is 17, which matches. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Each segment breaks up its text with a definitions block, a diagram, a table, steps or a check (s2-layers, s2-table, s3-steps, s5-table), and paragraphs stay at 1–3 short sentences.

The prerequisites name cc-02, cc-05, cc-08 and cc-09 by their exact titles. API is now spelled out in hook-b1 (「API（Application Programming Interface）のキーです。」). 「エフォート」 is in the glossary and is glossed where it is first used in s5-table (「高い[[エフォート]]（effort：考える量の設定）」). Each segment introduces at most 3 new terms. One small gap remains: e5 uses 「Console」 without a gloss, while cc-01 introduced it as 「Claude Console」.

This is a single-locale (jp) lesson and nothing is left untranslated. The diagram labels are Japanese and the alt describes the layered structure. Both links name their destination (「セキュリティの公式ドキュメント」「公式の料金ページ」).
